extraction.name: LongBench
extraction.description: LongBench is a bilingual, multi-task benchmark tailored for evaluating long context understanding in large language models. It comprises 21 datasets across 6 task categories in both English and Chinese, covering areas such as multi-document QA, single-document QA, summarization, few-shot learning, code completion, and synthetic tasks.
extraction.creator: Yushi Bai (Tsinghua University, Zhipu.AI); Xin Lv (Zhipu.AI); Jiajie Zhang (Tsinghua University, Zhipu.AI); Hongchang Lyu (Institute of Automation, Chinese Academy of Sciences); Jiankai Tang (Tsinghua University); Zhidian Huang (Tsinghua University); Zhengxiao Du (Tsinghua University, Zhipu.AI); Xiao Liu (Tsinghua University, Zhipu.AI); Aohan Zeng (Tsinghua University, Zhipu.AI); Lei Hou (Tsinghua University); Yuxiao Dong (Tsinghua University); Jie Tang (Tsinghua University); Juanzi Li (Tsinghua University)
extraction.citeAs: Yushi Bai, Xin Lv, Jiajie Zhang, Hongchang Lyu, Jiankai Tang, Zhidian Huang, Zhengxiao Du, Xiao Liu, Aohan Zeng, Lei Hou, Yuxiao Dong, Jie Tang, Juanzi Li. LongBench: A Bilingual, Multitask Benchmark for Long Context Understanding. arXiv:2308.14508v2, 2024.
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The dataset was assembled by extracting and sampling data from the test sets of 16 existing public datasets using random and uniform sampling to avoid test leakage, alongside manually curating 5 new datasets by collecting documents from multiple sources.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionType: Secondary Data analysis; Manual Human Curator
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Raw data consists of 16 existing public datasets (including NarrativeQA, HotpotQA, DuReader, GovReport, etc.), English and Chinese Wikipedia, the C4 dataset, WuDaoCorpora, GitHub repositories, Arxiv academic papers, Chinese Judgements Online, and Chinese Government Websites.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Three Ph.D. students annotated questions and groundtruth answers for each article in the MultiFieldQA dataset following guidelines to propose clear questions with definitive, short answers, random evidence distribution, and varied question types.
extraction.rai:annotatorDemographics: Ph.D. students with extensive research experience in the field of NLP
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: Potentially unreliable automatic metrics (ROUGE-L, F1 may not accurately reflect the quality of the response); Coupling with instruction-following capabilities (performance on LongBench is coupled with the models' instruction-following capabilities)
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Evaluating long context understanding of large language models; Serving as a testbed for future research in long context modeling
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: For synthetic tasks, passages were summarized using GPT-3.5-Turbo to create retrieval queries, and passages were randomly repeated and shuffled for counting tasks. For multi-document QA, distracting passages were arbitrarily selected and added to the context until a maximum length or document count was reached, and the passages were then randomly ordered.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: All datasets were standardized into a unified format. To avoid test leakage, data was extracted from the test sets of public datasets using either random sampling or uniform sampling based on length. Additionally, passages in TriviaQA with fewer than 1,000 words were filtered out.
